purpose: Current direct single-holder Responsibility relation from an Event to a Person in the bounded B09 temporal subset; this is not organizer or Participation semantics.

columns.name: event_ref
columns.meaning: Canonical Event whose current accountability is described.

columns.name: responsible_person_ref
columns.meaning: Person currently bearing Responsibility in the activated simple-holder subset; Account identity is not required.

columns.name: established_at
columns.meaning: Server-side accepted instant supplied by the future guarded B09-B operation.

primary_key.name: pk_event_responsibility
primary_key.reason: B09 activates one current simple Responsibility holder per Event; organizer/participant/joint semantics are not collapsed into it.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_responsibility_event
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Responsibility changes do not change Event identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_event_responsibility_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: B09 activates Person as the eligible holder subset; Person != Account and Responsibility != Participation/organizer.

indexes.name: pk_event_responsibility
indexes.reason: One current simple holder per Event in B09.

indexes.name: ix_event_responsibility_person_event
indexes.reason: Reverse lookup of Events currently borne by a Person.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Not Domain MaterialState; current direct semantic relation only.
state_history.current_binding: At most one current simple Responsibility Person for an Event in B09.
state_history.chronology: No product mutation exists in B09-A; B09-B must add governed operation/history semantics before reassignment is exposed.
state_history.immutability_policy: No direct runtime writes in B09-A.

lifecycle.retention: Absence means no current Responsibility assertion in this activated subset, not explicit open/unassigned state.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Runtime raw DELETE is denied; no reassignment surface exists in B09-A.

obligations: Responsibility remains distinct from Participation, organizer, expected performer, actual performer and Authority.
Holder is a Person NativeRef and does not require an Account.
Joint/collective/open/transfer semantics are not fabricated by the simple B09-A persistence subset.
